title: Family
definition: Family is God's design for relational life, care, instruction, love, responsibility, and generational faithfulness.
summary: Families are gifts from God, though every family is affected by sin and brokenness. Scripture calls families to love, teach, honor, serve, forgive, and point one another toward the Lord.
christFocus: Through Christ, believers are brought into the family of God, and earthly families are called to reflect His love and truth.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content: Families are gifts from God, though every family is affected by sin and brokenness. Scripture calls families to love, teach, honor, serve, forgive, and point one another toward the Lord.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: This doctrine matters because it helps believers follow Christ faithfully, think biblically, love others rightly, and live with wisdom, humility, and hope.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Receive this truth with humility, compare it with Scripture, bring it into prayer, and let it shape your relationships, choices, service, witness, and daily walk with Christ.
